name: multi-effect
description: One layout with three effects nested under it (ripples + lines + noise-2d). Exercises layer grouping, loop order, and top-down onAllocateMemory across multiple effects on shared geometry (mirrors v1 two-layers/four-layers intent with v2 modules). reparent (not set_control) is used so the structural nesting + loop order is what's tested, not just data resolution.
